title: Arctic Norway | Winter in Wonderland
highlights: Discover Arctic Norway, from the vibrant cities of Tromsø and Oslo to the untamed wilderness of Kirkenes and Hammerfest, capturing the essence of the north.
Sail on a stunning 2-night cruise from Tromsø to Kirkenes, passing snow-covered fjords and witnessing the Arctic’s dramatic coastline.
Stand at the edge of Europe’s northernmost point at the North Cape Plateau, taking in sweeping views of the Arctic Ocean.
Uncover the stories of Arctic exploration at the Polar Museum in Tromsø, home to fascinating exhibits on Norway’s polar history.
Explore the 700-year-old Akershus Fortress in Oslo, a landmark steeped in history and offering panoramic views of Norway’s capital.
overview:
About the tour:
With breathtaking fjords cuddled up amidst snow-clad mountain ranges, quaint coastal towns and the magnificent sight of the Northern Lights, Norway is a winter wonderland that came straight out of an artist's imagination. Your 9-day winter tour starts in Tromso, the winter wonderland of Norway and ends in Oslo. Offbeat destinations of Northern Norway and a fantastic combo of land and cruise through Norway's arctic circle will give you an experience out of the ordinary.


Quick info:
Start Point: Tromso Airport
End Point: Oslo Gardermoen Airport
Duration: 8 Days, 7 Nights
Destinations Covered: Tromso - Kirkenes - Oslo

Tromso City Walk on a Shared basis
1 night stay in Kirkenes with breakfast
Transfer from Oslo Airport, Gardermoen to Deluxe Hotel

know_before_you_go: All visitors are required to carry valid ID proof.
Meals in the restaurants or cafes are not included.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Travel insurance is not included in the package.
Kindly note that personal expenses are not included in the package and should be budgeted separately.
Any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary are not part of the package and require separate arrangements.
Alcoholic Drinks are not included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
International and Internal flights are not included as a part of the package.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrive in Tromso | Welcome to the Northern Lights Capital of Norway
days.desc: Welcome to Tromso, "the Northern Lights Capital of Norway." Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Check in and enjoy the day at leisure. You can visit various sites such as the Arctic Cathedral, famous for its striking architecture and the Northern Norway Art Museum, showcasing regional art. You can also take a ride on the Fjellheisen cable car to the Storsteinen mountain ledge, enjoying the panoramic views of Tromsø. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tromso Guided Walking Tour
days.desc: Head to the pre-decided spot and embark on a Tromso guided walking tour. Explore Stortorget, the bustling main square and stroll along Storgata Street, known for its vibrant shops and charming cafes. Admire the historic MS Polstjerna, a preserved whaling vessel, and visit the Tromsø Cathedral, notable for its beautiful stained glass. Pass by the Tromsø Town Hall with its distinctive architecture and delve into the rich history of Arctic exploration at the Polar Museum. Later return to the hotel.

items.title: Tromso City Walk on a Shared basis

days.title: Board Havila Cruise | Sail through the Norway's Northern Coast
days.desc: Today, check out from your hotel and head to the port to embark on your Havila cruise. After settling into your cabin, you can explore various excursions offered, such as thrilling dog sledding with huskies or traditional reindeer sledding. Explore Tromsø's walking theatre and immerse yourself in the Sami culture by engaging with their reindeer and learning about their rich traditions. Later, return to the cruise for a relaxing overnight stay, enjoying the comforts of your floating home.

items.title: See huskies in the wilderness of Tromsø
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Havila Cruise | A Journey As Far North As You Can Get
days.desc: On the second day of your cruise, you have a range of exciting activities to choose from. You can explore the North Cape plateau or embark on thrilling ATV safaris on Magerøya Island. You can even head out and interact with Sami families in Kjøllefjord or indulge in birdwatching near the dramatic North Cape. Discover other activities like experiencing the Arctic's magic under the Polar sky with exhilarating snowmobiling adventures. Later, return to the cruise for an overnight stay.

items.title: Snowshoeing and Ice Fishing in the Arctic
items.label: Suggestion

items.title: Visit a Sami family in Kjøllefjord
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Disembark at Kirkenes | To the Northernmost Europe
days.desc: Continue your Arctic adventures in Kirkenes and explore more thrilling activities like dog sledding, snowmobile safaris and the unique experience of king crab fishing. You can also visit the Snowhotel, where you can explore intricately carved ice rooms or visit the fascinating Norway–Russia border. After an exciting morning, disembark from the cruise and get transferred to your hotel in Kirkenes, where you'll check in and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

items.title: Catch King crab with a snowmobile
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Fly From Kirkenes to Oslo | Welcome to the capital city of Norway
days.desc: Today, check-out and board your transfer to the airport for your flight to Oslo (tickets not included). Upon arrival at Oslo airport, you'll be driven to the hotel. Check in and enjoy the day at leisure. You can visit the historic Akershus Fortress, a medieval castle offering panoramic views of the Oslofjord, or delve into the world of art at the Munch Museum. Alternatively, you can head to Bygdøy, a scenic peninsula known for its excellent museums. Later, return to the hotel.

days.title: Oslo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Start your day with a pickup at Haakon Vlls Gate 1 for an engaging Oslo sightseeing tour. Begin at the Vigeland Sculpture Park, where you’ll encounter over 200 remarkable sculptures. Next, explore the historic Akershus Fortress and marvel at the striking design of the Oslo Opera House. Dive into maritime heritage at the Fram Museum and explore other sites such as Royal Palace, National Theatre etc. Afterwards, you'll be driven back to the starting point and then, return to your hotel.

items.title: Oslo City Sightseeing Tour on a Shared basis

days.title: Departure
days.desc: In the morning, check-out and get transferred to the airport. This is where your trip comes to end while you board your flight back home.
